@concat('SELECT TO_CHAR(MESES.MES, ''YYYYMM'') AS ANOMES_VENDA, TO_CHAR(MESES.MES + (FAIXAS.INICIO_DIA - 1), ''YYYYMMDD'') AS DATA_INICIO, TO_CHAR(CASE WHEN FAIXAS.INICIO_DIA = 1 THEN MESES.MES + 10 WHEN FAIXAS.INICIO_DIA = 11 THEN MESES.MES + 20 ELSE ADD_MONTHS(MESES.MES, 1) END, ''YYYYMMDD'') AS DATA_FIM_EXCLUSIVA, TO_CHAR(MESES.MES + (FAIXAS.INICIO_DIA - 1), ''YYYYMMDD'') AS ARQUIVO_ANOMES FROM (SELECT ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''', pipeline().parameters.StartAnomes, ''', ''YYYYMM''), LEVEL - 1) AS MES FROM DUAL CONNECT BY ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''', pipeline().parameters.StartAnomes, ''', ''YYYYMM''), LEVEL - 1) < TO_DATE(''', pipeline().parameters.EndAnomesExclusive, ''', ''YYYYMM'')) MESES CROSS JOIN (SELECT 1 AS INICIO_DIA FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 11 AS INICIO_DIA FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 21 AS INICIO_DIA FROM DUAL) FAIXAS ORDER BY 1, 2')

query.value: @concat('SELECT e.entity_name, COALESCE(p.status, ''MISSING'') AS status, COALESCE(p.publication_version, 0) AS publication_version, p.run_id, p.target_ref, COALESCE(c.last_consumed_version, 0) AS last_consumed_version, CASE WHEN p.status = ''SUCCESS'' AND COALESCE(p.publication_version, 0) > COALESCE(c.last_consumed_version, 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS should_copy FROM (SELECT ''', item().entityName, '''::text AS entity_name) e LEFT JOIN public.etl_publication_control p ON p.entity_name = e.entity_name LEFT JOIN public.etl_consumer_control c ON c.consumer_name = ''adf_powerbi'' AND c.entity_name = e.entity_name')
